verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own materials describe in-product AI that turns session and device data into insights: Session Insights summarizes cases, spots patterns and highlights insights. They also describe an AI troubleshooting assistant that gives device-specific answers, and AI that analyzes screenshots and error logs. All of this comes from marketing and pricing pages, with no in-depth documentation or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights and suggestions are generated and surfaced, hands-on or independent corroboration, and detail on which data sources feed proactive suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
Session Insights: Our AI-powered note-taker compiles a summary for each case, spots patterns, highlights insights
Use advanced TeamViewer AI to analyze data, from screenshots to error logs.
Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
